description: RoboCup Rescue Simulation server is published by RoboRescue community. The RoboCup Rescue server runs simulated urban-disaster environments for rescue agents. Its stated coverage is Configurable disaster-city maps. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The README specifies Java and build requirements; server execution and maps were not downloaded or tested. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
